description.value:
You can channel the potency of the stars to mark your foes. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Zenith Star] domain spell. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, and you can Refocus by carefully practicing the steps of the stellar dance. Your domain spells from the stellar dancer archetype are primal spells. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your spellcasting attribute is Charisma.

In addition, when you Cast a Spell while you're in Stellar Dance Stance, your dance reaches its zenith, and you can choose for the additional damage dealt as a result of the stance to be of the same type as the damage dealt by the spell, if any.
